title: The Diagnostic Cost of Reducing ECG Lead Information for High-Sensitivity Detection of Occlusion Myocardial Infarction
description: Analysis code for reproducible comparison of four ECG lead-information configurations for high-sensitivity detection of angiography-defined occlusion myocardial infarction, including patient-grouped OOF analysis and STAFF III controlled-occlusion analysis.
